fee_notes: Standard initial fee is $45,000 ($10,000 due at signing, $35,000 due at opening). Discounts available: (1) Second or subsequent location: $22,500 (same ownership group); (2) Qualified Employee Program (36+ months full-time specialty running retail): $35,000; (3) VetFran Program (U.S. Armed Forces veterans): $35,000 for first location. VetFran discount cannot be combined with other discounts. Discount savings become due if location is sold/transferred/assigned before or within one year of opening. Fee is fully waived for existing franchisees exchanging older Franchise Agreement for current form. Partial refund (50% of first installment) available if no site is agreed upon within 6 months.
raw_excerpt:
INITIAL FRANCHISE FEE. The initial fee for your Franchised Business is $45,000 unless you qualify for certain discounts. Of this amount, $10,000 is due when you sign the Franchise Agreement. This initial payment may be partially refundable under the circumstances below. The balance of $35,000 will be due at the opening of the Franchised Business and is non-refundable.

DISCOUNTS. We offer a reduced initial fee of $22,500 for a second or subsequent new Franchised Business that is opened for business (if the ownership group is the same as the first franchise).
